experiences.description: Architected an enterprise multi-agent financial platform using LangGraph, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Neo4j, while establishing automated ETL pipelines and a 6-layer evaluation framework with Langfuse observability.
Engineered and deployed an enterprise RAG chatbot and data pipelines using Python, Databricks, and Azure AI Search, alongside entity resolution algorithms and automated workflow routing.
Spearheaded marketing analytics by building RFM customer segmentation models and cross-channel performance metrics from transaction and Meta ad data to optimize retention and budget allocation.
